headline: Mod browsing and updates join fixes for sound, controls and phone graphics
summary: The Development line gained a mod index with dependency installation, automatic updates and rollback. Game changes address Windows sound gaps and slow diagonal stick movement, while Enhanced graphics received optimisations for phone GPUs. Desktop setup and debugging also gained Steam integration, display scaling and inspection tools.
highlights: The launcher can install linked mods, resolve dependencies and share a setup (#161).
Diagonal stick pushes now preserve the movement speed of straight pushes (#168).
Windows audio mixes ahead of the device to avoid gaps; Vulkan becomes the default renderer (#188).
Enhanced graphics gains phone GPU optimisations and Android frame timing headroom (#165, #181).
Windows fixes restore Orxon's electric barrier strands and correct explosion particle colours (#171, #178).
An Object Viewer, local lighting, freecam and culling inspection landed (#195, #196).
